title: Know Your Zone
description:
Hurricane Evacuation Zones are provided by Florida county governments and compiled through the Statewide Regional Evacuation Studies program. This application allows users to search an address or location to identify whether it falls within a designated hurricane evacuation zone.

Evacuation zones are used by local emergency management officials to support hurricane evacuation planning, public preparedness, and evacuation order decision-making. Evacuation zones are not the same as flood zones and are primarily used to identify areas that may be vulnerable to storm surge and related hurricane impacts.

The latest statewide evacuation zone GIS data can be downloaded here:
https://maps.floridadisaster.org/data/2026_Evacuation_Zones.zip

Once the link above is selected, a download will initiate in your browser. GIS data is packaged in .zip format.

Users should always follow official evacuation orders and guidance issued by their local county emergency management agency.

licenseInfo:
This application is intended for informational and emergency preparedness purposes only. Evacuation zones shown in this application are approximate and should not be used for legal, engineering, surveying, navigation, or other site-specific determinations.

Evacuation orders are issued by local officials and may vary by event based on storm conditions, forecast impacts, local risk, and public safety needs. Users should follow official evacuation orders and guidance from their county emergency management agency.

The Florida Division of Emergency Management does not assume legal liability or responsibility arising from the use of this product in a manner not intended by the author.

Use is limited to showing approximate evacuation zone information for preparedness and situational awareness.
